changes: Selected rows from Japanese Wikipedia color-name lists using name occurrence in JIS, DIC, Sanzo Wada or Pantone references; extracted names and HEX; normalized HEX case; retained previously selected individual-article color values and their fixed-revision sources; added aliases, readings and collection membership. No article prose, images, or vendor color values.

classification.representative: First displayed name in the source list, normalized with NFKC.
classification.japanese: Representative name does not start with a katakana character (U+30A0–U+30FF).
classification.world: Every selected entry, including all Japanese colors.

nameReferenceNotes: Names corroborated against JIS conventional color names (269), DIC Japanese traditional color names (300, using published retailer names), Sanzo Wada color names (159, using digital transcriptions and original scans), and the Pantone FHI name list (2625). These sources confirm names only; displayed values come from the linked Wikipedia revisions and are not official vendor color matches.
